q: The Pythagorean theorem in information geometry states that for three distributions P, Q, R where R is the e-geodesic projection of P onto an m-flat submanifold (or vice versa):
exp: Pythagorean theorem: if R is the e-projection of P onto an m-flat submanifold containing Q (or the m-projection onto an e-flat submanifold), then D(P||Q) = D(P||R) + D(R||Q). This is the information-geometric analogue of the Pythagorean theorem.
